content.name: Hex

components.m: the petrified eye of a newt

entries: You place a curse on a creature that you can see within range. Until the spell ends, you deal an extra {@damage 1d6} Necrotic damage to the target whenever you hit it with an attack roll. Also, choose one ability when you cast the spell. The target has {@variantrule Disadvantage|SRD52} on ability checks made with the chosen ability.
If the target drops to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|SRD52} before this spell ends, you can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|SRD52} on a later turn to curse a new creature.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: Your {@status Concentration|SRD52} can last longer with a spell slot of level 2 (up to 4 hours), 3-4 (up to 8 hours), or 5+ (24 hours).
